title: ESG 企業動畫培訓課程：第一幕・開場危機

voice_performance.performance_intent: Scene 1.1: Cold, precise, prestigious British executive English. Scene 1.2: Anxious, rapid-fire, comedic Mandarin office panic. Scene 1.3: Hyper-enthusiastic TV shopping pitch.
voice_performance.energy_curve: Starts restrained and analytical, explodes into high-tension comedic panic at the phone call, ends with surreal TV shopping parody.
voice_performance.pause_policy: Dramatic beats after Harrison's questions and ON HOLD stamp reverberation.

sections.label: Sandy Financial Pitch
sections.text: Mr. Harrison, as you can see, the financial projections are solid. Gross margins are healthy, and their market share is growing.
sections.speaker_directions: Sandy presents with professional confidence, gesturing toward the corporate financial growth chart.

sections.label: Harrison Non-Financial Question
sections.text: And the non-financials? Where do they stand on ESG metrics?
sections.speaker_directions: Mr. Harrison cuts through the optimism with a sharp, calculating tone, eyes narrowing.

sections.label: Sandy Awkward Admission
sections.text: That is... precisely the issue, sir. We have zero data on their emissions, and no verification of labor standards.
sections.speaker_directions: Sandy hesitates awkwardly, clicking remote to show empty warning charts, nervous vocal tremor.

sections.label: Harrison Black Box Verdict
sections.text: So, it's a black box. We can't verify if their healthy margins come from efficiency... or exploitation. We are flying blind here.
sections.speaker_directions: Mr. Harrison taps fingers on the polished wood table, grim and resolute.

sections.label: Sandy Feeble Rebuttal
sections.text: but, the potential return is still attractive...
sections.speaker_directions: Sandy attempts a weak defense, trailing off under Harrison's gaze.

sections.label: Harrison Final Rejection
sections.text: Risk is not attractive. Put it on hold. I want to see a credible ESG roadmap from them before we proceed. Make that clear to them.
sections.speaker_directions: Harrison firmly shuts his folder, absolute executive finality.

sections.label: Supervisor Urgent Alert
sections.text: Amy！大事不妙！增資案被卡住了！投資方說我們是個「ESG黑箱」，不相信我們的財務報表！
sections.speaker_directions: 主管透過電話狂吼，氣喘吁吁，神情極度焦慮，汗珠狂飆。

sections.label: Supervisor Bonus Threat
sections.text: 如果這筆錢沒進來，明年的擴廠計畫不但要停，連大家的年終獎金恐怕都發不出來了！
sections.speaker_directions: 主管用力揮舞雙手，聲音充滿絕望與威脅感。

sections.label: Amy Shocked Question
sections.text: 這麼嚴重？可是協理，我們公司不是一直都很守規矩嗎？
sections.speaker_directions: Amy 睜大眼睛，神情震撼且困惑，握緊手機不敢置信。

sections.label: Supervisor Assignment
sections.text: 現在沒時間解釋！下禮拜有場高階主管會議，妳就先準備一場ESG簡報吧！
sections.speaker_directions: 主管強行打斷，急躁地指派不可能的任務。

sections.label: Amy Hesitant Confession
sections.speaker_directions: Amy 眉頭緊鎖，眼神慌亂，聲音微弱而無助。

sections.label: Supervisor Final Push and Hangup
sections.text: 不懂就去搞懂啊！這關係到公司的生存，也關係到妳我的飯碗！就這樣！我要去安撫老闆了！
sections.speaker_directions: 主管聲嘶力竭大吼後立即掛斷，留下盲音。

sections.label: Amy Monologue
sections.text: E...S...G...這到底是什麼救命仙丹？能幫公司募資？還能救我的年終獎金？
sections.speaker_directions: Amy 呆滯地看著黑掉的手機螢幕，喃喃自語，雙眼緩緩失焦。

sections.label: Fantasy TV Shopping Host
sections.text: 還在擔心年終獎金泡湯嗎？試試全新的「ESG濃縮膠囊」！一口吞下，保證你訂單滿載，股價飆升，老闆笑呵呵！
sections.speaker_directions: 主管化身浮誇購物台主持人，咧嘴大笑，激動捧著金光閃閃的藥罐向鏡頭狂推銷。
